entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello? I'd like to make a return.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Alex. I can certainly help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number?
Yes, the name is Sam Jones, and the order number is VF886753.

Thank you, Sam. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Apex Pro helmet. Looks like that was delivered about 82 days ago. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet?
Oh, there's no real issue. It was a gift, but the person decided they wanted a different color. The box is still completely sealed, in fact, the shipping box is unopened.
I see. So it's more of a preference on the color, not a technical fault. I'm just checking our policy for you now.

Excellent. Well, I have good news. For that helmet, our return window is 90 days, so you are well within the timeframe for a full refund. We want to make sure everyone has the right gear for their safety and style.

That's great, thank you. I appreciate you making that easy. Since I'm returning it with the box unopened and saving you some processing, is there any chance you could issue a 10% discount code for my next order? I was planning to buy the correct helmet from you anyway.

I'm glad we could approve the return for you. While I can't add a discount code on top of a full refund, I can assure you the return process will be quick and seamless. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed immediately.
Alright, that's fair. A full refund works for me. What are the next steps?

I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email on file. Simply print it, attach it to the package, and drop it off at your local shipping center. Once our warehouse scans it in, the refund will hit your account in 3-5 business days. Can I help with anything else today?
No, that's all. Thank you for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome, Sam. Thanks for calling VeloFit and have a wonderful day.
